name: 6-fluoro-DET
summary: 6-Fluoro-DET, or 6-F-DET, also known as 6-fluoro-N,N-diethyltryptamine, is a substituted tryptamine derivative related to psychedelic drugs such as diethyltryptamine (DET).

pharmacology.text: 6-Fluoro-DET acts as a partial agonist at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, but while it produces similar physiological effects to psychedelics, it does not appear to produce psychedelic effects itself even at high doses. Relatedly, 6-F-DET does not substitute for LSD in drug discrimination tests and does not produce the head-twitch response in rodents.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.text: 6-Fluoro-DET produces physiological effects but does not produce hallucinogenic effects in humans.

summaryZh: 6-F-DET是一種有機氟化合物，化學式為C14H19FN2，結構上與DET、5-F-DET類似，可作為5-HT2A受體的部分激動劑。

sideEffects.en: It produces the bodily effects of psychedelics, such as dilated pupils, a faster heartbeat and raised blood pressure, without hallucinations. Little else is known about its risks.
sideEffects.zh: 它會產生迷幻藥的身體反應，例如瞳孔放大、心跳加快與血壓升高，但不引起幻覺。關於它其他的風險，所知甚少。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会产生迷幻药的身体反应，例如瞳孔放大、心跳加快与血压升高，但不引起幻觉。关于它其他的风险，所知甚少。

fact.en: It is one of the rare compounds that switches on the 5-HT2A receptor and produces the bodily effects of a psychedelic without the hallucinations, which made it useful as a control in older psychiatric research.
fact.zh: 它是少數會活化5-HT2A受體、產生迷幻藥的身體反應卻不引起幻覺的化合物之一，因此在早期精神醫學研究中常被用作對照藥物。
fact.zhHans: 它是少数会活化5-HT2A受体、产生迷幻药的身体反应却不引起幻觉的化合物之一，因此在早期精神医学研究中常被用作对照药物。
